projects.name: Automation Engine — AI Desktop App Tester
projects.status: active development (FID-6 advanced tester in progress)
projects.description: An offline AI agent that tests any Windows desktop app the way a human would: give it an app and it perceives the UI (UIA tree + OCR), decides one action per turn via a code-first decision ladder (cache → rules → small LLM → large LLM), acts through raw SendInput, verifies every action against falsifiable post-conditions, and remembers via a state graph and learned recipes. Includes flow recording/replay, parameterized exercises with generated test cases, endurance metrics with leak detection, crash triage tooling (crashdoctor), incident evidence bundles, and self-contained HTML reports. Fully offline: loopback-only LLM, safety enforced in code (deny lists, destructive-action refusal, focus guard), never by prompt.
